title: lepisorus asterolepis
intro: Lepisorus asterolepis, commonly known as the Chinese lace fern, is a type of plant belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being.
